mutants.description: gordon_value uses r + g in the denominator (sign error on the growth term)
gordon_value accepts r equal to g and divides by zero instead of raising ValueError
ddm_value discounts dividend t by (1+r) to the power t-1 (beginning-of-year timing)
ddm_value sets the terminal value to D_N over (r-g), dropping the one-period growth step
ddm_value discounts the terminal value by (1+r) to the power N-1
fcfe_value_per_share applies the growth factor twice to the terminal FCFE
residual_income_value charges the cost of equity on ending book value B_t instead of B_(t-1)
residual_income_value rolls book value forward without deducting dividends (B_t = B_(t-1) + NI_t)
scenario_price_target_cents rounds with Python round(), which sends an exact half-cent tie to the even cent
scenario_price_target_cents accepts probabilities whose sum is within 1e-9 of 1 instead of exactly 1
